notes: This record supersedes the two earlier Issue #88 JSON records listed in relation; those files remain unchanged.
The six-row catalogue ran in one device session: five measured rows and one expected host-only preflight rejection.
The power trace was read after all rows and device close; its nine samples cover run_start through run_end.
Status pass requires rows, board and firmware provenance, pinned image/toolchain, clean harness identity, complete power coverage, and device close.
Device 1 was selected by verified PCI identity; its board serial is 0000040331914124 and device 0 was not used.
No Watcher was used because the kernel was unchanged; the external run cap was 60 seconds.
No host name or user-specific absolute path is included in this record.

host_accounting.accounting_scope: Board-free host preflight: circular-buffer pages, resident tensors, largest assigned core, and static L1 prefix.

l16_same_placement.placement: R in L1 for both variants
l16_same_placement.interpretation: FP32-R improves true-inverse error while the beam-pattern metric does not improve; the existing 1e-2 matching-reference gate passes.

a_fp32_r_effect_equal_r_dram.interpretation: At equal R-in-DRAM placement, FP32-R improves true-inverse and MV-direction metrics, but not the beam-pattern metric.

b_bf16_r_placement_effect.interpretation: The BF16-R numerical metrics are unchanged; the small timing difference is the placement control result for this run.

c_default_to_fp32_r_dram.interpretation: This is the complete default-to-nearest-fitting FP32-R comparison; it combines precision and R-placement effects.
